text: see if u can write a script that can tell me where in @cart/hmsc-int/model.json my car is not symmmetric i can see it but i dont know which vertex it is lol
resolution: Wrote scripts/check-symmetry.js, a reusable v8cli script that pinpoints where a Studio model.json is not symmetric. It reads the model, auto-picks the symmetry axis (the one with the fewest offenders about the origin plane — for the user's car that is Z, left/right) or takes an explicit x|y|z arg, and lists every vertex with no mirror twin within tolerance: its index, position, where its twin should be, and the nearest actual vertex with the distance off, sorted worst-first so the most visible asymmetry is at the top. Ran it on cart/hmsc-int/model.json: symmetric axis = Z, 44 verts off, worst = vert 97 (off 0.39) and the pair vert 72/94 (off 0.29), clustered near the centre/nose. Committed 8155eeaa2.
